title: London: how the fire stopped
hook: What changed after the flames began spreading?

predict.question: What helped bring the fire under control?

frames.heading: Westward spread
frames.text: Strong winds drive fire through the City.

frames.heading: Under control
frames.text: Weaker wind and firebreaks slow the spread.

reveal: The changing conditions matter alongside the starting point. Closely packed buildings and strong winds helped the fire spread. Demolition created breaks, and weaker winds slowed it. London Museum places it under control by the fourth day; this schematic does not reconstruct each street’s burn time.
limit: The line indicates broad spread, not an exact fire perimeter or daily extent.
